services.name: Paddleboarding Big Lake
services.desc: Big Lake has year-round public water access and sits about 10 minutes from our Sedro-Woolley pickup rack. Use this guide to sort out the launch, the gear, and the right amount of time for your day before you leave home. Big Lake sits east of Mount Vernon in Skagit County. The Washington Department of Fish and Wildlife access area has a concrete ramp, boarding float, parking, and a restroom, which makes it a straightforward place to arrive with a SUP. NorthWest Paddle Rentals is not at the lake: the boards are picked up and returned in Sedro-Woolley, roughly 10 minutes away, so plan that short drive into both ends of your rental.
